newsitem.title: USA: Inland Steel requests dumping inquiry.
newsitem.headline: Inland Steel requests dumping inquiry.

text.p: A unit of Inland Steel Industries Inc and USS/KOBE Steel Co said on Monday they have requested a federal inquiry to end what they allege are attempts by German and British steelmakers to get around anti-dumping provisions.

Inland Steel Bar Co and USS/KOBE said that, since an anti-dumping order and subsidy duties were imposed in 1993 on finished lead and bismuth bars, British and German companies have increased imports of semifinished leaded steel billets to circumvent the duties.
"As a result, prices of both lead and bismuth bars have eroded dramatically in 1996," a spokesman for Indland Steel Bar said in a news release.
"We are taking this action to end circumvention of the orders -- which should end the price erosion that intensified in 1996."
USS/KOBE is a joint venture of USX-US Steel Group and Kobe Steel Ltd.
